title: Why Is the Sea Around Madeira So Deep Blue?
description: Because deep water starts close to the shore and the sea here holds little plankton. Water absorbs red light, and with little to turn it green, it stays blue.
heroAlt: Looking down over the side of a white boat into deep, clear blue water
keywords: why is the sea around Madeira so deep blue
why is Madeira water so blue
how deep is the sea around Madeira
